settings.heading: Key Benefits of LED Light Therapy Treatment

settings.text:
• Zero downtime means you can walk straight out of the treatment room selfie-ready—no redness, peeling, or awkward recovery period to hide.
  • LED light therapy is safe for every skin tone and is even pregnancy-friendly when your GP gives the green light, so virtually anyone can enjoy its benefits without worry.

settings.heading: Popular Concerns Treated with LED Light Therapy

settings.text:
• LED light therapy effectively tackles persistent or hormonal acne and blackheads by eliminating C. acnes bacteria and calming overactive oil glands.
  • It reduces inflammatory redness—including rosacea flare-ups and post-sun flush—by minimising dilated capillaries and soothing irritated skin.
  • Fine lines and loss of elasticity around the eyes and mouth soften as red and near-infrared wavelengths stimulate fresh collagen and improve skin firmness.
  • Stubborn dark circles and puffiness under the eyes diminish thanks to boosted micro-circulation and a gentle anti-inflammatory effect.
  • Post-procedure healing—after microneedling, chemical peels, or tattoo removal—speeds up dramatically as LED light accelerates cellular repair and slashes downtime.
  • For sensitive or eczema-prone complexions, LED helps rebuild the skin barrier, easing discomfort and reducing flare-ups over time.
  • Bundle a series or add LED as a post-treatment upgrade—our flexible pricing meets both your complexion goals and your budget.

settings.heading: Does it hurt?
settings.content: Not at all. You’ll feel gentle warmth, most clients describe it as sun-bathing without the UV.

settings.heading: Is LED safe for dark or sensitive skin?
settings.content: Yes. The wavelengths target cellular energy, not melanin, so there’s no risk of hyper- or hypopigmentation.

settings.heading: How soon will I see results?
settings.content: Many notice calmer, brighter skin within 24 hours. Acne improvement typically appears after 4–6 sessions, while collagen gains peak after a 6-week course.

settings.heading: Can I combine LED with other treatments?
settings.content: Absolutely. LED is the ideal add-on to microneedling, peels, or injectables, speeding healing and enhancing results.

settings.heading: How much does it cost?
settings.content: Single sessions are budget-friendly, and multi-session bundles unlock our best per-visit rate. Add-on pricing is even lower, ask us for today’s specials.
